{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''factory''' located on the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] [[Homeworld/Legends|spawnworld]] of [[Colla IV/Legends|Colla IV]] served as the main manufacturing facility for the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched a [[Battle of Colla IV (Clone Wars)|strike]] against the Colicoids, four battlegroups infiltrated the facility in order to end the production of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Reaching the innermost wall, they were attacked by a [[Scorpenek annihilator droid/Legends|Scorpenek annihilator droid]] that destroyed a [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] barrier of the factory serving as the [[Cloning/Legends|clone's]] cover and killed three battlegroups until the remaining [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] fled the scene.
